item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, sophisticated editorial still life. One elegant smoked amber glass candle vessel with creamy ivory wax and a small natural flame, minimal matte ivory paper label with refined typography reading 'AMBRE' and smaller 'SCENTED CANDLE', brushed brass lid resting beside it. Set on warm ivory travertine stone with subtle natural texture, warm taupe seamless background. A small piece of amber resin and a single understated botanical sprig positioned discreetly near the base to suggest fragrance. Soft directional studio light from upper left, beautiful controlled highlights on glass, delicate realistic shadow, subtle warm glow, rich tactile materials, restrained neutral palette, elegant negative space, impeccably styled high-end fragrance campaign, photorealistic, crisp product detail, shallow depth of field, 85mm commercial product photography. No extra candles, no clutter, no watermark.
